text:
[issue by Rithenar]
### Describe the bug

When adding a 5th item in the ME Requester, it changes the first item that was already there, to the one item you just placed to autocraft in slot 5

### How to reproduce the bug

1- Place items 1-4 in the ME Requester
2- Place the 5th item, see first one change
3- Try to remember what you put in first slot

### Expected behavior

for Requester not to change items when adding a new one

### Additional details

_No response_

### Which minecraft version are you using?

1.21

### On which mod loaders does it happen?

NeoForge

### Crash log

https://gist.github.com/Rithenar/9edb75821dee3bed31f8f72876f9b278

[comment by Mari023 (collaborator)]
The ME Requester is from an addon, you should report it on their issue tracker: https://github.com/AlmostReliable/merequester/issues
